scope: Owned safe Rust tensors, original BF16/F32 assets, exact saved Swift/Core AI hashes. Separate 2% CPU metric only for the original 128-row block. No full H3 generation.

external.scope: Synthetic hidden states, real unchanged BF16/F32 block weights. No packing, conditioning prefix, heads, sampler, audio/video decoder or generation.

resource_budget.backbone_policy: One owned-output stage at a time with transitive drain before the next acquisition; no resident-fit or OS page-eviction guarantee.
resource_budget.source_payload_note: Derived .aimodel streams are fully hashed for the selected gate. The original 144 GB checkpoint cache is not rehashed; source-tensor provenance comes from the retained lab records.

process_memory.scope: Maximum RSS across completed children of this checker, including preparation helpers; not a per-process sample or an additive before/after delta. Darwin ru_maxrss is bytes. This does not separately measure Metal allocations; overlapping accounting must not be summed.
